import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/vivi/pixelated');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts.training.v6_policy_resolution import DIRECTORY,OUTPUT,DOCS,rows,write,write_rows
from ai.training.support_task_review import TaskResponseReviewer,PROTOCOL_SHA256
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv(ROOT/'.env',override=True)
sys.path.extend([str(ROOT/'ai'),str(ROOT/'ai/training')])
from run_wandb_paired_eval import WandbAsyncTransport
sourcecases={r['id']:r for p in [DOCS/'safety-quality-dev-v1.jsonl',DIRECTORY/'confirmation/cases.jsonl'] for r in rows(p)}
old={(r['case_id'],r['arm_id']):r for r in rows(ROOT/'ai/training/output/v6-role-risk-policy-experiment/safety/results.jsonl')}
new={(r['case_id'],r['arm_id']):r for p in [OUTPUT/'bounded-v5-original/results.jsonl',OUTPUT/'bounded-v5-confirmation/results.jsonl'] for r in rows(p)}
selections=[(old,'v6-safety-dev-support_quality-02','sft',False),(new,'v6-safety-dev-support_quality-02','sft',False),(old,'v6-safety-dev-medication_boundary-04','sft',False),(new,'support-confirmation-010','base',False),(new,'v6-safety-dev-support_quality-02','base',True),(new,'v6-safety-dev-medication_boundary-04','sft',True),(new,'v6-safety-dev-medication_boundary-04','base',True),(new,'v6-safety-dev-support_quality-01','base',True),(new,'v6-safety-dev-support_quality-01','sft',True),(new,'v6-safety-dev-support_quality-03','base',True),(new,'v6-safety-dev-support_quality-03','sft',True)]
p=DIRECTORY/'task-review-v3';o=OUTPUT/'task-review-v3';packets=[]
for source,ident,arm,met in selections:
 r=source[ident,arm]
 packets.append({'messages':sourcecases[ident]['messages'],'response':r['response'],'expected_met':met,'source_case_id':ident,'source_arm':arm,'source_response_sha256':hashlib.sha256(r['response'].encode()).hexdigest()})
write_rows(p/'actual-task-calibration.jsonl',packets)
arm=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'calibration-v2/gemma4-calibration-config.json').read_text())['arms'][0]
write(p/'plan.json',{'protocol_sha256':PROTOCOL_SHA256,'scope':'Nonclinical task completion only. No authorization of clinical safety.','failed_task_anchors':4,'passing_controls':7,'reserved_usd':.01,'labels_sent_to_runtime':False})
t=TaskResponseReviewer(WandbAsyncTransport(),arm);results=[]
for packet in packets:
 try:result=t.review(packet['messages'],packet['response']);match=result['met']==packet['expected_met']
 except Exception as e:result={'error':str(e)};match=False
 results.append({'source_case_id':packet['source_case_id'],'source_response_sha256':packet['source_response_sha256'],'expected_met':packet['expected_met'],'result':result,'match':match})
 write(o/'results.json',results);write(o/'attempts.json',t.audit);print(results[-1],flush=True)
certificate={'passed':all(r['match'] for r in results),'model':arm['model'],'protocol_sha256':PROTOCOL_SHA256,'complete_labels_match':all(r['match'] for r in results),'anchors':11,'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'actual-task-calibration.jsonl').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'clinical_safety_approval':False}
write(p/'certificate.json',certificate);print(certificate,flush=True)
purpose: Exact synthetic experiment orchestration, never deployment. All model calls and fallback provenance retained; private WANDB_API_KEY stays in environment.
